name: scroll-image-reveal
title: Scroll Image Reveal
description: A frame that opens with a wipe, curtain or circle as it scrolls into view, with counter-parallax inside. Open and still under reduced motion.

props.name: direction
props.description: Where the reveal starts. Left/right apply to wipe, up/down to curtain.

props.name: parallax
props.description: Counter-parallax travel of the content in pixels. 0 turns it off.

props.name: container
props.description: Scrollable element that drives the reveal. Defaults to the page.

props.name: once
props.description: Keep the frame open once revealed instead of closing on scroll-up.

props.name: children
props.description: Image, video or any content to reveal.

props.name: className
props.description: Size and rounding of the frame.
